title: On $\mathfrak{X}$-transitive groups and conjugate separable $\mathfrak{X}$-subgroups
summary: For a given variety of groups $\X$, we develop a systematic theory of $\CSX$-groups and $\XT$-groups, extending ideas proposed in \cite{Shah}. We analyze the interplay between these classes, describe their structural properties, and examine their connections with equational domains and residually $A$-free groups. Furthermore, we prove by elementary means that every finite $\CSX$-group lies in $\X$.
